whatIs.question: What is Plusplus?
whatIs.answer: Plusplus AG is Switzerland's leading stablecoin partner for real-life applications. Based in Zug, we specialize in making stablecoins accessible and compliant for individuals and institutions across Switzerland. We bridge the gap between traditional finance and blockchain innovation by creating practical products that leverage Swiss Franc stablecoins like Frankencoin (ZCHF). Our two core products—Rental Solutions for digital deposits and Corporate Treasury for institutional liquidity—demonstrate how stablecoins solve real-world financial challenges. We combine Swiss regulatory excellence with blockchain technology, ensuring every customer experiences institutional-grade security, compliance, and transparency.

products.question: What services and products does Plusplus offer?
products.answer: Plusplus offers two Swiss-compliant stablecoin solutions: (1) Rental Solutions—manage rental deposits in Frankencoin (ZCHF) with 3% annual yield or Bitcoin, providing fair returns for tenants while simplifying processes for landlords through our Zinsli partnership. (2) Corporate Treasury—institutional-grade liquidity management using Frankencoin, enabling Swiss companies to optimize cash reserves with stable returns in Swiss Francs. Both products are built on the foundation of Frankencoin, Switzerland's most robust and over-collateralized Swiss Franc stablecoin. We handle all technical complexity, regulatory compliance, and our proprietary custody solution, allowing our clients to access stablecoin benefits without blockchain expertise.

howItWorks.question: How does Plusplus work?
howItWorks.answer: Plusplus simplifies stablecoin adoption by handling all technical and regulatory complexity. For Rental Solutions: Tenants deposit funds, which Plusplus converts to Frankencoin (ZCHF) and holds in individual custody accounts, generating yield while maintaining full legal compliance with Swiss rental law. For Corporate Treasury: Companies deposit reserves, which are deployed in Frankencoin savings modules for stable returns. Plusplus manages security, regulatory KYC/AML requirements, DeFi protocol integration, and provides a proprietary custody solution.

benefits.question: What are the benefits of using Plusplus?
benefits.answer: Plusplus delivers stablecoin benefits tailored to Swiss needs: (1) Regulatory Compliance—operate with peace of mind under Swiss law and international standards; (2) Yield Generation—access 3% annual returns on deposits versus near-zero bank rates; (3) Transparency—every transaction is verifiable on-chain, eliminating counterparty risk; (4) Cost Efficiency—eliminate intermediaries and processing delays; (5) Security—benefit from Frankencoin's over-collateralization and Plusplus' proprietary custody. For Rental Solutions, tenants benefit from fair returns while landlords simplify deposit management. For Corporate Treasury, companies optimize cash reserves with institutional infrastructure. All benefits come with Swiss regulatory oversight and without requiring technical blockchain knowledge.

security.question: How are my funds secured?
security.answer: Plusplus implements institutional-grade security through our proprietary custody solution: (1) State-of-the-Art Custody—advanced security infrastructure designed and operated by Plusplus; (2) Over-Collateralization—Frankencoin is collateralized by real-world assets, audited regularly; (3) Segregated Accounts—individual custody per customer ensures funds remain separate and secure; (4) Smart Contract Audits—all deployed contracts undergo third-party security audits; (5) Swiss Compliance—regulated under Swiss AML/KYC standards with regular security assessments. Your stablecoins remain segregated in your name while Plusplus' infrastructure ensures safe management and accessibility.

risks.question: What are the risks of using Plusplus?
risks.answer: Plusplus transparently communicates stablecoin risks: (1) Smart Contract Risk—code vulnerabilities despite audits; we mitigate through established protocols and continuous monitoring. (2) Protocol Risk—underlying DeFi protocols may experience technical issues; we diversify across vetted platforms. (3) Regulatory Risk—stablecoin regulations may change; Plusplus actively ensures Swiss compliance and works with regulators. (4) Market Risk—while Frankencoin targets 1:1 peg to CHF through collateralization, extreme market stress could impact stability. (5) Operational Risk—system interruptions, though rare, could limit access; we maintain redundancy and incident protocols. (6) Yield Risk—future returns may differ from current 3% (November 2025) based on market conditions. Each product includes detailed risk disclosures. Review specific product risk documents before investing.

access.question: How can I access my funds? Are there restrictions?
access.answer: Plusplus designs stablecoin access around practical Swiss needs: For Rental Solutions, rental law determines timing—you may withdraw after tenancy ends or with mutual landlord-tenant agreement, following Art. 257e Swiss OR requirements. For Corporate Treasury, institutional accounts can withdraw on business days with typical settlement in 1-2 business days. Frankencoin maintains continuous on-chain liquidity and can be traded 24/7 on decentralized exchanges if needed. Emergency procedures exist for time-sensitive needs. All access rights and timelines are clearly documented in your product agreement. No hidden restrictions apply—your funds remain yours, held in individual custody under Swiss law.

regulation.question: Is Plusplus regulated?
regulation.answer: Plusplus AG is registered in Zug and operates under Swiss financial regulations. We comply fully with Swiss AML/KYC requirements. For Rental Solutions, we comply with Swiss rental law (Art. 257e OR) requirements for deposit management and legal protections. Frankencoin itself is a Swiss Franc stablecoin operating under established DeFi governance. Plusplus is an active VQF member. Our Corporate Treasury offerings meet institutional compliance standards. We implement rigorous KYC/AML procedures, regularly updating compliance frameworks as Swiss stablecoin regulation evolves. Our proprietary custody solution operates within Switzerland's strict regulatory framework.

privacy.question: How is my privacy protected?
privacy.answer: Plusplus protects your privacy under Swiss Federal Data Protection Act (nDSG) and GDPR standards. Personal data is collected only for service delivery and regulatory compliance—never sold or shared with unregulated third parties. We use bank-grade encryption for all data storage and transmission, with security audits ensuring compliance. Your stablecoins themselves operate on public blockchain (Ethereum), providing full transaction transparency while personal identity remains protected through regulated custody. You maintain control of personal information with rights to access, correct, or delete at any time. Regulatory requirements (KYC/AML) mandate limited sharing with Swiss authorities and partners—all under strict confidentiality agreements. Our Privacy Policy provides complete details on data handling.

section4.title: 4. International Data Transfers
section4.content: Personal data are transferred only to countries with an adequate level of protection (Switzerland, EU, UK, Canada, U.S. companies under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework). For transfers to other countries, we use Standard Contractual Clauses.

section6.content: Under Articles 15–20 GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, and data portability. To exercise these rights, contact us at info@plusplus.swiss.

specialConditions.title: Special Conditions for Rental Deposits via the Zinsli Platform

general.title: I. General and Scope of Application
general.text1: 1. The following special conditions for rental deposits via the "Zinsli Platform" (hereinafter Special Conditions) govern the contractual relationship between Plusplus AG, c/o Alexander Brozek, Poststrasse 22, 6300 Zug, Switzerland, (hereinafter Plusplus) as well as tenants and landlords for services of Plusplus in connection with the management of rental deposits according to Art. 257e OR, where applicable, via the platform of Zinsli Finance AG (www.zinsli.com) (hereinafter Zinsli Platform, the services the SERVICES).
general.text2: 2. These special provisions apply in addition to the General Terms and Conditions of Plusplus (hereinafter T&C). In the event of deviations or contradictions, these special provisions shall take precedence over the T&C.
general.text3: 3. Plusplus provides its SERVICES exclusively on the basis of these special provisions, any additional agreements, the T&C as well as the current version of the privacy policy as published on the Plusplus website. These special conditions apply to the use of all services offered by Plusplus, including all content, functions and services in connection with the SERVICES. By using the SERVICES or when registering to use services of Plusplus via the Zinsli Platform, the tenant or landlord accepts these special conditions.

deposit.title: II. Opening of a Rental Deposit and Exchange by Plusplus
deposit.text1: 1. Tenants and landlords can agree via the Zinsli Platform that the rental deposit for depositing their rental security according to Art. 257e OR is deposited by investment in payment tokens (hereinafter TOKEN).
deposit.intro: 2. By registering, the tenant confirms that they:
deposit.requirement1: Are either a Swiss citizen or a foreigner in possession of a residence permit B, B (recognized refugee), C or F;
deposit.requirement2: The rental property for which the rental deposit is opened is located in Switzerland; and
deposit.requirement3: Have read and accepted the T&C and meet the additional requirements contained therein.
deposit.text2: 3. Via the Zinsli Platform, tenants and landlords give their consent to the investment of the rental security in TOKEN and thereby instruct Plusplus to hold their rental security available at all times for the tenant in the form of the TOKEN they have chosen in an individually created and technically segregated DLT depot per tenant (hereinafter DEPOT). During the custody period, only Plusplus has access to the DEPOT. According to Art. 257e OR, the owner of the DEPOT remains the respective tenant.
deposit.text3: 4. Plusplus is authorized to unilaterally make changes to the offered selection options and offered products at any time.
deposit.text4: 5. Payment by the tenant is made by bank transfer and must be made via a Swiss bank account of the tenant that is in their name.
deposit.text5: 6. After receipt of payment of the deposit at Plusplus by bank transfer, Plusplus exchanges the deposit into the desired TOKEN and transfers them to the DEPOT. The conversion of funds into TOKEN by Plusplus is carried out via third-party providers and without any discretion on the part of Plusplus.
deposit.text6: 7. Tenants and landlords have been informed about the risk disclosure according to section X of the T&C as well as the product-specific information about investment risks.

losses.title: III. Losses and Use of Returns
losses.text1: 1. The tenants acknowledge that the products they have chosen may be volatile and subject to value fluctuations, for which the tenant alone bears the risk.
losses.text2: 2. If returns accrue on the tenant's DEPOT, the tenant agrees that any returns, capital gains or other increases in value, insofar as legally permissible, continue to serve as liability substrate as part of the rental deposit according to Art. 257e OR and the tenant has no claim to the surrender of these increases in value outside the provisions in Art. 257e para. 3 and 4 OR until the dissolution of the rental deposit. The tenant also waives the assertion of any partial payout claims.
losses.text3: 3. The landlord is aware that value fluctuations or technical problems or regulatory developments can lead to the agreed deposit being temporarily undercut or becoming completely worthless. In this context, the landlord waives vis-à-vis Plusplus and the tenant the assertion of additional securities or the performance of additional payments.
losses.text4: 4. Tenants and landlords acknowledge that there is no guarantee that the rental deposit will generate profit or cover the original deposit amount. In particular, tenants and landlords acknowledge that a total loss is possible.

duration.title: IV. Further Provisions During the Duration of the Rental Deposit
duration.text1: 1. Subject to the complete dissolution of the rental deposit, tenants and landlords waive partial payouts from the DEPOT for the duration of the SERVICES.
duration.text2: 2. Tenants and landlords cannot make changes to the product selection during the duration of custody of the rental deposit in the DEPOT until its dissolution.
duration.text3: 3. Subject to the complete dissolution and payout of the rental deposit according to section V hereinafter, there is no claim at any time to repayment of the bank transfer made by the tenant to Plusplus.
duration.text4: 4. Subject to the complete dissolution of the rental deposit according to section V hereinafter, tenants and landlords waive payouts from the DEPOT.

dissolution.title: V. Dissolution of the Rental Deposit
dissolution.text1: 1. The use of Plusplus's SERVICES requires a valid contractual relationship with Zinsli Finance AG for the use of the Zinsli Platform. Regardless of the conditions below, a termination by the tenant or landlord vis-à-vis Zinsli Finance AG automatically leads to the termination of the contractual relationship with Plusplus.
dissolution.text2: 2. The dissolution of the rental deposit is carried out according to the legal regulations in Art. 257e para. 3 OR. Accordingly, Plusplus is only entitled to pay out the depot if tenant and landlord have agreed to this, a legally binding payment order or legally binding court judgment exists, or the landlord has not asserted any claim during one year after termination of the rental relationship.
dissolution.text3: 3. The dissolution of the rental deposit is carried out via the termination function or notification function provided for the tenant or landlord on the Zinsli Platform. It can also be done by registered mail.
dissolution.text4: 4. In the case of termination by Plusplus or dissolution of the rental deposit by the tenant or landlord, the TOKEN are held available for the tenant at all times according to the provisions of the T&C until payout, subject to the rental law provisions according to Art. 257e para. 3 OR.
dissolution.text5: 5. If the tenant decides to continue to have the TOKEN held available by Plusplus within the framework of the T&C for the duration of the rental deposit, Plusplus conducts an extended examination according to the Swiss Anti-Money Laundering Act (AMLA). The tenant must provide all additional information and documents required for Plusplus for this purpose. Plusplus reserves the right to refuse the customer relationship without giving reasons.
dissolution.text6: 6. Plusplus is not liable for damages or lost profits arising from delayed or failed liquidation of a DEPOT upon termination or dissolution of the rental deposit.

specialFees.title: VI. Fees
specialFees.text1: 1. Plusplus charges tenants and landlords fees according to the currently valid price list, which can be accessed on the website, until the payout of the rental deposit. All fees are understood to be without any additional costs that tenants or landlords owe in connection with the Zinsli Platform.
specialFees.text2: 2. Plusplus may directly offset fees with any credit held available for the tenant at all times on DEPOTS and charge individually held TOKEN via the tenant's DEPOT or when conducting a transaction/conversion. Furthermore, Plusplus is authorized to charge any claims against the tenant or landlord, including fees, to the payment methods deposited by the tenant or landlord.
specialFees.text3: 3. Plusplus is authorized to charge the customer the applicable value-added tax as well as other taxes and fees arising in connection with the provision of the SERVICES or to offset them with the customer's credit/claims.
specialFees.text4: 4. Plusplus reserves the right to changes and adjustments to the fee regulations. Every change must be communicated to the tenant or landlord by email and is deemed approved if the tenant or landlord does not object to the change within 30 days. Otherwise, the fee provisions of the T&C apply.
